description: 🆕 Since Pectra an EOA can carry EIP-7702 delegated code (the 0xef0100 designator): every call to the wallet executes the DELEGATE's contract with the wallet's funds — a malicious delegate is total takeover, invisible to approval tools. Reads the designator, resolves the delegate and verdicts it: not_delegated / delegated_known (Coinbase's EOA→SmartWallet path) / delegated_unknown (🚨) / smart_contract. The drain surface no other Base tool checks.
